profiles.title: Restrained
profiles.description: A brief acknowledgement and a small dry reaction. Hold the ongoing intent through pauses.

profiles.title: Expressive
profiles.description: Let the same dry reaction and acknowledgement linger. Audio, artwork, and conversational beats stay the same.

eyePolicy.blink: Reuse deterministic pack idle blinks and closed-eye family transitions.
eyePolicy.gaze: Reuse pack look-left, look-right and settle cels only when its idle scheduler selects them. Do not force a glance into these short scenes.
eyePolicy.reaction: Finite named-preset hold; do not enable the looping reaction cel tour.
eyePolicy.reducedMotion: Disable incidental blink and gaze motion; explicit playback may retain native speech cels and necessary preset transitions.
